scope: All 222Emails, Chelston personal, Retention School and LinkedIn Content OS visual generation, review, packaging and publication workflows.
hardRule: ONE CONCEPT = ONE CANVAS = ONE FINAL IMAGE.
prohibited: multi-panel preview containing multiple finished posts
single image that attempts to show a batch of separate social posts
mockup showing multiple separate finished assets at once
batchRule: A batch may contain multiple files, but every file must contain exactly one finished concept. Never compress a batch into one image.
generationPromptPrefix: HARD CONSTRAINT: Create exactly ONE standalone finished social-media asset for ONE concept only. Use the entire canvas for this single idea. Do not create a collage, grid, contact sheet, montage, moodboard, diptych, triptych, split-screen of separate concepts, thumbnail board, multi-post preview, or multiple finished designs inside one image. If the request mentions a batch, output only one independent image for the current concept; the next concept must be generated as a separate file in a separate generation. One concept = one canvas = one final image.
truthRules: No invented client outcomes, recovered revenue, conversion rates or social engagement metrics.
No fake dashboards or interfaces presented as evidence.
Illustrative maths must be explicitly labelled illustrative if used.
Use verified claims only where source evidence is available.
Generated decorative details must not imply factual proof.
brandRules: Revenue Recovery and Client Return Systems positioning must remain clear.
No em dashes in final copy.
Do not generate a fake or altered logo when an exact approved logo is required; typeset or source-lock exact branding separately.

automaticFailIf: more than one separate finished concept appears on the canvas
the image is a contact sheet or concept grid
the batch is represented as one combined image
critical text is unreadable at mobile-feed size
qa.onFailure: Reject the asset. Do not publish, package, source-lock or use it as a style reference. Regenerate the same concept as one standalone image before proceeding.

publicationContract: Passing visual QA is necessary but not publication permission. Existing owner approval, source-lock, Buffer capacity, cadence, deduplication and publication-verification controls remain authoritative.
